its lane away from it. When obstacles such as traffic cones are detected ahead in the lane,
the system slows appropriately and plans an avoidance path, either going around the obstacle
within the lane or changing lanes to pass it.

With NZP on, NZP selects suitable lanes along the navigation route, takes on and off ramps
automatically, and overtakes when the vehicle ahead is slow. The driver can also turn on
a turn signal and the system will assist with a lane change in that direction; the signal
turns off automatically once the lane change is complete.

the main road. In heavy traffic, if the system cannot complete a lane change, it will ask
for your help; be ready to take over the vehicle promptly.
